tagline.zh-CN: 知识随时间产生复利。本地优先的双链知识库与 AI 认知镜像
tagline.en: Accrue Notes — Where knowledge accrues over time.

description.zh-CN: Accrue Notes（复利笔记）是一款本地优先的深度思考与知识复利工具。结合 Markdown 双向链接与实体知识图谱构建私有认知网络，内置 3D 全景心智星网、白盒 AI 深度问答、思维模型红队沙盘、十维专业研报矩阵与 LaTeX 高保真排版导出。零账号、零服务器、零埋点，纯本地存储与 BYOK 自带密钥，保护个人思想与知识资产。基础功能免费，进阶能力 Pro 支持超值年度订阅（¥168/年 · 约 ¥14/月）与月度订阅（¥19.9/月），全包含所有知识母体与进阶特权。
description.en: Accrue Notes is a local-first deep thinking and knowledge compounding tool. Combining Markdown bi-directional links with an entity knowledge graph, it features a 3D interactive mindscape constellation, a white-box AI cognitive mirror, mental model red-teaming, a 10-dimensional research matrix, and publication-grade LaTeX math exports. Zero accounts, zero tracking, local-only storage, and bring-your-own-key (BYOK) privacy. Core features free; Pro subscription available in discounted Annual (¥168/yr · ~¥14/mo) and flexible Monthly (¥19.9/mo) plans with all knowledge packs included.

name.zh-CN: 本地优先、双链与 3D 全景心智星网

summary.zh-CN: 让碎片化笔记像宇宙星网与神经突触一样自发互联，以 3D 拓扑视角俯瞰终身生长的私有知识大脑。
summary.en: Interconnect fragmented notes like neural synapses and cosmic constellations, navigating your lifelong knowledge brain in 3D.

detail.zh-CN: 全面支持标准 Markdown 语法与 [[双链]] 语法。输入双括号即可智能自动补全已有笔记与实体；支持正向链接与反向链接（Backlinks）实时双向索引。配合宏伟的 3D 全景心智星网与局部突触雷达，直观呈现思想脉络的有机衍生与跨学科概念聚类，让每一条孤立想法成为认知网络中的活跃星宿。
detail.en: Full support for standard Markdown and [[wiki-style bi-directional links]]. Type brackets for real-time note and entity autocompletion with live bidirectional backlinks. A breathtaking 3D mindscape constellation and local synaptic radar turn isolated notes into vibrant cosmic clusters of interconnected wisdom.

name.zh-CN: AI 认知镜像与白盒对话

summary.zh-CN: 基于真实笔记库的私有认知助手，拒绝幻觉，具备可溯源的思考推理链。
summary.en: A private cognitive assistant grounded in your notes, zero hallucinations, with transparent reasoning chains.

detail.zh-CN: 内置混合检索机制（语义向量 Embeddings + 实体知识图谱 Hybrid RAG）。AI 问答支持可展开的透明思考过程（Thinking Process）与精确引文溯源卡片（Ref Quotes），点击引文一秒直达源笔记段落。温和体贴地倾听日常碎碎念，严谨深刻地探讨复杂学术议题。
detail.en: Built on hybrid retrieval combining semantic vector embeddings and knowledge graph entities. Features transparent, expandable thinking chains and verbatim reference citation cards that jump directly to source notes. Empathic for daily reflections, rigorous for academic research.

name.zh-CN: 十维专业深度研报矩阵

summary.zh-CN: 一键萃取知识库精华，多角度全景推演，从离散素材直达决策级综述报告。
summary.en: Synthesize notes into multi-angle panoramic research reports from scattered ideas to structured decisions.

detail.zh-CN: 针对任何笔记主题或复杂议题，一键调用十维深度研究工作流：涵盖事实沉淀、概念演化脉络、观点矛盾矩阵、反直觉洞见挖掘、第一性原理推演、跨学科类比与可落地行动清单。支持按维度自由定制，极大放大你的个人智识产出效率。
detail.en: Transform any topic into a 10-dimensional analytical report: fact aggregation, conceptual lineage, contradiction mapping, counter-intuitive insights, first-principles deduction, cross-domain analogies, and actionable checklists.

name.zh-CN: 思维模型沙盘与红队对抗

summary.zh-CN: 引入查理·芒格格栅思维模型，AI 化身高水平思想对手发起批判性辩论。
summary.en: Apply Charlie Munger's mental model latticework; AI acts as an intellectual sparring partner.

detail.zh-CN: 预置第一性原理、逆向思考（Inversion）、奥卡姆剃刀、费曼学习法、二阶思维等数十种经典思维工具。开启「红队对抗」（Red Teaming）模式后，AI 会主动寻找你论据中的逻辑漏洞、未明假设与认知偏差，逼近更扎实的本质思考。
detail.en: Pre-loaded with First Principles, Inversion, Occam's Razor, Feynman Technique, and Second-Order Thinking. In Red Team mode, AI actively probes for logical flaws, unstated assumptions, and cognitive biases to sharpen your conclusions.

name.zh-CN: LaTeX 严谨数学公式与高保真导出

summary.zh-CN: 原生 KaTeX 引擎像素级排版，一键导出含高清公式的矢量 PDF 与 Word 文档。
summary.en: Pixel-perfect KaTeX equation rendering with direct export to publication-ready PDF and Word (.docx).

detail.zh-CN: 深度集成 KaTeX 数学排版引擎，完美支持复杂行内公式 $E=mc^2$ 与多行块级公式矩阵。研发独家公式矢量光栅化渲染管道，解决传统 Markdown 工具导出公式变形或乱码的问题，一键导出学术期刊级 PDF 与排版整洁的 Word (.docx) 文件。
detail.en: Deeply integrated KaTeX math rendering supporting inline equations and complex display matrices. Our proprietary high-resolution rasterization pipeline ensures flawless formula fidelity when exporting to academic PDF and Microsoft Word (.docx).

name.zh-CN: 绝对隐私与 BYOK 自带密钥
name.en: Absolute Privacy & Bring Your Own Key

summary.zh-CN: 纯本地离线运行，零云端中转服务器，基础功能免费，进阶 Pro 提供超值年付（¥168/年）与月付（¥19.9/月）。
summary.en: 100% on-device operation, zero middleman servers. Core features free; Pro offers discounted Annual (¥168/yr) and Monthly (¥19.9/mo) plans.

detail.zh-CN: 数据 100% 保存在本地 SQLite 数据库与沙盒文件中。无注册、无登录、无任何行为埋点或第三方广告 SDK。AI 功能采用 BYOK（Bring Your Own Key）模式，API Key 加密存放在系统级硬件安全芯片中。基础功能免费提供 50 篇笔记及次月起每月赠送额度；进阶 Pro 提供立省 30% 的超值年付（¥168/年，折合 ¥14/月）与灵活月付（¥19.9/月），全包含全部 6 套知识母体，应用商店官方安全扣费，随心取消，终身不锁死数据。
detail.en: Data remains 100% in your local SQLite database and sandbox. Zero accounts, zero tracking, zero ad SDKs. AI uses Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) with hardware keychain encryption. Core features include 50 free notes plus monthly free allowances. Pro unlocks unlimited notes and knowledge packs via discounted Annual (¥168/yr · ~¥14/mo, save >30%) or flexible Monthly (¥19.9/mo) subscriptions through official app stores. Cancel anytime, zero data lock-in.

q.zh-CN: Accrue 复利笔记 是什么？它与普通笔记软件有什么区别？
q.en: What is Accrue Notes, and how is it different from traditional note-taking apps?

a.zh-CN: Accrue Notes 是一款专为终身学习者、研究员与深度思考者设计的本地优先双链知识库与 AI 认知镜像。它通过 Markdown 双向链接与知识图谱串联笔记，结合自带 API Key 的白盒 AI 深度问答、思维模型红队沙盘和十维研报矩阵，帮助你将零散记录沉淀为可复利的认知资产。
a.en: Accrue Notes is a local-first bi-directional knowledge base and AI cognitive mirror crafted for lifelong learners, researchers, and thinkers. It weaves notes through [[bi-directional links]] and knowledge graphs, combined with BYOK white-box AI Q&A, mental model red-teaming, and a 10D research matrix to compound your knowledge into lifelong cognitive assets.

q.zh-CN: 我的数据保存在哪里？如何保障隐私安全？
q.en: Where is my data stored, and how is my privacy protected?

a.zh-CN: 你的所有笔记、附件、实体和向量索引全部 100% 存储在设备本地（SQLite 与沙盒文件）。应用没有注册登录系统，不包含任何跟踪、统计或广告 SDK。AI 功能直连你选择的大模型提供商，API 密钥加密保存在系统安全区（iOS Keychain / Android Keystore），发送前完全透明。
a.en: All your notes, attachments, entities, and vector indexes remain 100% on your local device (SQLite and sandbox documents). There is zero registration or user tracking. AI calls connect directly to your chosen provider with keys encrypted in hardware security (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore).

q.zh-CN: 什么是 BYOK？AI 功能如何计费？
q.en: What is BYOK, and how are AI features billed?

a.zh-CN: BYOK 即「自带 API Key」（Bring Your Own Key）。你可以自由填写 OpenAI、Anthropic Claude、DeepSeek、Google Gemini 等服务商的 API 密钥。所有 AI 计费直接在你的模型服务商后台按实际调用 Token 结算（通常每次深度问答仅需分厘），Accrue Notes 不收取任何 AI 订阅溢价或中转费用。
a.en: BYOK stands for Bring Your Own Key. You can use your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, and more. Usage is billed directly by your chosen provider based on token consumption (usually fractions of a cent per query). Accrue Notes adds no markup or subscription fee.

q.zh-CN: 没有网络或断网时能正常记笔记吗？
q.en: Can I use Accrue Notes without an internet connection?

a.zh-CN: 完全可以。除联网调用你配置的 AI 大模型外，应用的所有核心功能——包括 Markdown 编辑、双链跳转、实体图谱浏览、本地全文检索、公式渲染、PDF/Word 导出等——全部在本地离线运行。
a.en: Absolutely. Except for connecting to your chosen AI model provider, all core features—Markdown editing, bi-directional linking, knowledge graph browsing, full-text search, KaTeX rendering, and PDF/Word exports—run entirely offline.

q.zh-CN: 如何备份与跨设备同步我的笔记数据？
q.en: How do I back up and sync my notes across devices?

a.zh-CN: 你的笔记完全属于你。你可以一键将全部笔记导出为标准 Markdown 文件（包含 YAML 元数据），也可以导出为 SQLite 完整快照、高清 PDF 或 Word 文档。支持通过 iOS 系统的私有 iCloud 容器进行无缝多端同步，我们没有任何途径访问该私有容器。
a.en: You own your data completely. You can export all notes to standard Markdown files (with YAML metadata), full SQLite snapshots, or publication-ready PDF and Word documents. On iOS, you can enable private iCloud container sync which is fully encrypted and inaccessible to us.

q.zh-CN: Accrue Notes Pro 包含什么？年度与月度订阅如何收费与取消？
q.en: What does Accrue Notes Pro include, and how does Annual vs Monthly billing and cancellation work?

a.zh-CN: Accrue Notes 基础功能永久免费（含 50 篇笔记基础额度，额度用尽后次月起每个月赠送 5 次记录）。Pro 高级功能提供两种灵活的订阅选项：超值年度订阅（¥168/年，折合仅 ¥14/月，立省 >30%，最受欢迎）与灵活月度订阅（¥19.9/月）。订阅即可解锁突破 50 篇限制的无限笔记、3D 全景心智星网、无限次 AI 专属 Agent 深度剖析、包含全部 6 套精选专业知识母体、数据私有备份同步及学术级无损导出。所有购买均由对应应用商店（Apple App Store / Google Play / 华为应用市场）官方安全扣费，你可以随时在系统应用商店的「订阅管理」中自主取消续订，已有数据永久属于你，终身不锁死。
a.en: Accrue Notes core features are free forever (with 50 free notes and 5 free monthly notes thereafter). Pro advanced capabilities are available in two flexible options: the best-value Annual Plan at ¥168/year (~¥14/month, save >30%, most popular) and the flexible Monthly Plan at ¥19.9/month. Pro unlocks unlimited notes, the 3D mindscape constellation, unlimited AI deep analysis, all 6 premium knowledge packs, private backups/sync, and publication-ready academic export. Subscriptions are securely processed by official app stores (Apple App Store / Google Play / Huawei AppGallery) and can be cancelled anytime in your store account settings with zero data lock-in.
